youtube.title: Stompy's Colors! (HIC!) | Nerdy Noodles
youtube.description:
🦖 HIC! Stompy the dinosaur got the hiccups, and one big HIC bounced all of Stompy's colors away! Can you help Stompy find them?

Learn 7 colors with Stompy: red, orange, yellow, green, blue, purple and white! Each color comes back one by one in its own place (the farm, the ocean, the pond, the forest, the sky and the city), and you hear the REAL sounds of the yellow duck, the blue bird and the white sheep. Then sing the color song with Stompy, and stay till the end, because one more color is hiding behind the board! 👀

Perfect for toddlers, preschoolers and kindergarten kids (ages 2-6).

✨ In this video, kids will:
✔️ Learn 7 colors: red, orange, yellow, green, blue, purple and white
✔️ Match each color to a thing: red apple, green tree, blue bird and more
✔️ Hear real duck, bird and sheep sounds
✔️ Sing a color song with Stompy!

⏱️ Chapters
